description: This file defines the DefaultHealthCheckConfig class, an immutable configuration implementation for health check settings in the Gateway service, including timeout, basic health check settings, and cluster role configurations.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Immutable class representing the default implementation of the health check configuration for the Gateway service, providing settings such as service timeout, basic health check configurations, and cluster roles.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultHealthCheckConfig instance from a given Config object, applying fallback handling and extracting specific configurations.

methods.name: getServiceTimeout
methods.description: Returns the duration after which the health check service times out.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether the health check is enabled based on the basic health check config.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration between health checks from the basic health check configuration.

methods.name: getClusterRolesConfig
methods.description: Returns the cluster roles configuration object associated with the health check.
